time_convention: t = frame / fps; frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale guessed

camera.motion: static (background is uniform purple RGB ~(164,88,194) with no features; nothing in the frame changes except the truck, so no pan or shake is detectable or expected)
camera.view: top-down (bird's-eye) view of the truck; motion plane = image plane
camera.perspective_note: mild perspective: truck's apparent length is 534 px when centred in the image (frames 23-32) and grows towards the edges (560 px at frame 0, x~1511; 545 px at frame 47, x~274) because the tall truck's side faces show at oblique angles. Width is constant (~160 px body).

objects.name: truck
objects.description: fire-rescue truck seen from above: white/grey cab roof with 'FIRE-RESCUE' lettering and a red light bar at the front (left), dark chassis, dark-blue flat bed with red trim and a red crane/hose fitting behind the cab, magenta tail lights at the rear (right). Only object in the scene.
objects.direction: leftwards (-x), cab first; vertical position constant at y ~539.5
objects.visible_frames: 0-68 (fully inside frame 0-47; cut by the left image edge 48-68; gone 69-72)
objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = bbox centre (frames 0-47); frames 48-68 = rear edge x1 minus a quadratic-in-x1 fit of (x1 - bbox centre) from frames 0-47 (+-2 px)

static_objects: none: background is a uniform purple plane with no markings

events.event: truck already moving at the first frame (no visible start of motion)
front edge reaches left image edge (x0 = 2 at frame 47, 0 at frame 48)
last frame with any part of the truck visible (rear sliver, 5 px)

motion_observation: straight horizontal motion, no direction change, no bounce/contact. Per-frame displacement of the reference point is near constant (~26.3-26.5 px/frame; bbox centre 1511.5 -> 274.0 over frames 0-47), i.e. no visible acceleration. Answering sessions should fit their own model from tracks/truck.csv.

files.tracks/truck_raw.csv: raw segmentation output (bbox, mask centroid, extents) before reference-point handling
files.scripts/: measure.py (segmentation), finalize.py (track + widths), overlay.py (visual check), background.py (background/camera check)
